--- a/lib/runtime/safe_pattern.ts
+++ b/lib/runtime/safe_pattern.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+const MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH = 1000
+
+/**
+ * Safely construct a RegExp from a (possibly untrusted) pattern string.
+ * Used for $data references to the pattern keyword to prevent ReDoS.
+ * Throws if the pattern is too long or exhibits constructs that commonly
+ * lead to catastrophic backtracking.
+ */
+function safePattern(pattern: string, flags?: string): RegExp {
+  if (typeof pattern !== "string") {
+    throw new Error("Invalid pattern: must be a string")
+  }
+  if (pattern.length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Invalid pattern: exceeds maximum length of ${MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH}`
+    )
+  }
+  if (isUnsafeRegex(pattern)) {
+    throw new Error(
+      "Invalid pattern: potentially catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS)"
+    )
+  }
+  return new RegExp(pattern, flags)
+}
+
+/**
+ * Heuristic ReDoS check: reject nested quantifiers and quantified alternations,
+ * the primary causes of catastrophic backtracking (e.g. "(a|a)*", "(a+)+").
+ */
+function isUnsafeRegex(source: string): boolean {
+  // Replace escapes and character classes with placeholders so their contents
+  // are not mistaken for quantifiers / alternations / groups.
+  let s = source.replace(/\\[\s\S]/g, "x")
+  s = s.replace(/\[(?:[^\]\\]|\\.)*\]/g, "x")
+
+  // Quantified group that itself contains a quantifier: (a+)+, (a*)*, (a+){2}, …
+  if (/\((?:[^()]*[+*?{][^()]*)\)[+*?{]/.test(s)) return true
+
+  // Quantified group that contains alternation: (a|a)*, (ab|a)+, …
+  if (/\((?:[^()]*\|[^()]*)\)[+*?{]/.test(s)) return true
+
+  // Nested groups with an inner quantifier and outer quantifier: ((a)*)*, (a(b+)c)+
+  if (/\([^()]*\([^()]*[+*?{][^()]*\)[^()]*\)[+*?{]/.test(s)) return true
+
+  return false
+}
+
+// for standalone code generation
+// @ts-ignore
+safePattern.code = 'require("ajv/dist/runtime/safe_pattern").default'
+
+export default safePattern
